analysis.reasonEn: The wait-and-see stance continues for the third consecutive session. RSI at 43.1 has exited oversold territory but remains in neutral. MACD histogram shows improvement, a positive sign, yet bearish convergence persists. A Higher Low pattern is forming with the 5-day low at 95,920 KRW above the 20-day low at 82,500 KRW. The trading volume ratio of 1.60x is a positive indicator, but conviction for a trend reversal is lacking.
